== Summary ==
Players in the bar room of Zu Den Vier Winden, Bochum, shortly after midnight on 18 October 2015, during the [[2015 European Championship]]. The people are not named in the post.

* '''Event:''' [[2015 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2015-10-27
